zh.text: 實證性和規範性的陳述
一項實證的陳述
永遠是對的。
可以被事實推翻。
可能包含了價值判斷。

en.text: may be the same as a normative statement if certain values are shared by many people.

zh.text: 對擁有某些相同價值取向的大眾而言，可能等同於一項規範性陳述。
香港中學文憑考試 樣本試卷 卷一 第 3 題

en.text: Which of the following statements are positive statements?

zh.text: 下列哪些是實證性陳述？

en.text: More workers will be employed on a part-time basis after the imposition of a minimum wage.

zh.text: 最低工資實施後，更多工人會以兼職的形式獲聘。

en.text: Less low skilled workers will be unemployed after the imposition of a minimum wage.

zh.text: 最低工資實施後，低技術工人會有較少人失業。

en.text: Meal times should be counted as working time in the calculation of a minimum wage.

zh.text: 在計算最低工資時，膳食時間應被計入工作時間。

en.text: The imposition of a minimum wage widens the income gap between the rich and the poor.

zh.text: 最低工資的實施擴大貧富的收入差距。
香港中學文憑考試 2012 卷一 第 1 題

en.text: Which of the following are positive statements?

zh.text: 下列哪些是實證性陳述？

en.text: Importation of labour from the mainland would result in a rise in job vacancies in Hong Kong.

zh.text: 從內地輸入勞工會增加本港的職位空缺。

en.text: It would be better to import labour from the Guangdong province because they can speak Cantonese.

zh.text: 從廣東省輸入勞工會較佳，因為他們能操粵語。

en.text: Productivity of labour from China is higher than that from other Southeast Asian countries.

zh.text: 來自中國的勞工的生產力比來自其他東南亞國家的勞工高。

en.text: Unemployment rate in Hong Kong would rise by 1% as a result of labour importation of 30 000 from the mainland.

zh.text: 從內地輸入 30 000 名勞工會令本港的失業率上升 1%。
香港中學文憑考試 2015 卷一 第 1 題

en.text: The following statements are adapted from the 2017-18 Budget Speech by the Financial Secretary of Hong Kong.
Statement (1): The global economy in 2016 recorded the slowest growth since the global financial crisis.
Statement (2): For 2016 as a whole, there was a growth of 1.9%, consistent with the 1% to 2% economic
growth as forecast in last year’s Budget.
Statement (3): While recognising the effect of market forces, the Government should play an active role as a
facilitator by taking forward appropriate policies with good use of public resources.
Which of the above is a normative statement / are normative statements?

zh.text: 下列陳述是取材自香港財政司司長的 2017-18 年度財政預算案演詞。
陳述 (1): 	2016 年環球經濟錄得自環球金融危機以來最慢的增長。
陳述 (2): 	2016 年全年經濟增長率為 1.9%，符合去年預算案所估算的 1% 至 2%。
陳述 (3): 	在認同市場力量的同時，政府應積極發揮促進者的角色，善用公共資源，推出合宜的政策。
以上哪 (些) 項是規範性陳述？
只有 (1)
只有 (3)
香港中學文憑考試 2018 卷一 第 4 題

en.text: Refer to the following statements made by Peter and Mary.

zh.text: 參閱下列彼得和瑪莉所作的陳述。

en.text: Peter: As a developed economy, Hong Kong’s Gini coefficient is too high.

zh.text: 彼得：香港作為一已發展經濟體，它的堅尼系數太高了。

en.text: Mary: Hong Kong’s Gini coefficient is the highest in Asia.

zh.text: 瑪莉：香港的堅尼系數是全亞洲最高的。

en.text: Peter’s ... positive ... most people agree with it

zh.text: 彼得 ... 實證性 ... 大部分人認同該陳述

en.text: Peter’s ... normative ... it is inconsistent with the real world data

zh.text: 彼得 ... 規範性 ... 該陳述和現實世界的數據並不相符

en.text: Mary’s ... positive ... it can be rejected by fact

zh.text: 瑪莉 ... 實證性 ... 該陳述可以被事實推翻

en.text: Mary’s ... normative ... value judgment is involved in the statement

zh.text: 瑪莉 ... 規範性 ... 該陳述涉及價值判斷
香港中學文憑考試 2021 卷一 第 1 題

en.text: Which of the following is a normative statement / are normative statements?

zh.text: 以下哪項／哪些是規範性陳述？
只有(1)
只有(3)

en.text: Launching consumption voucher schemes will lead to inflation.

zh.text: 推行消費券計劃會導致通脹。

en.text: Promoting tourism is the most appropriate way to stimulate economic growth.

zh.text: 宣傳旅遊業是刺激經濟增長的最適切的途徑。

en.text: The government should continue to attract Mainland enterprises to invest in Hong Kong.

zh.text: 政府應繼續吸引內地企業來港投資。
香港中學文憑考試 2023 卷一 第 4 題
